title: provider-auth -01: make the source-domain field REQUIRED and signed (From or its successor)
description: Jason found Haven had treated From as optional because mimi-protocol-07 §4.1 has an editor's note questioning From (maybe From-Host). Once requests are signed, the source-domain field is what the signature binds to, so it cannot be optional. In -01: §5.2 Signing Requests and §12 Replacement Text say the source-domain field is REQUIRED on every MIMI request and MUST be covered by the signature; state that this applies to From or to whatever field replaces it. Keep the Open Issues bullet but point at the new mimi-protocol issue. mimid: verifier rejects a request with no From (or a From not covered) when the DNS-key mechanism is in use. Source: Jason Bolduc's review on mimi@ietf.org, 15 Nov 2026 (Message-ID CA+7d1z=LQ+iuYYum-z-SUssV8X5PJgeZL7EW5R2f0Jd4FkzTvA@mail.gmail.com); Mark committed to it publicly in his reply of 16 Nov (IETF notes/2026-11-16-mimi-provider-auth-jason-reply-sent.md). Draft source: ~/PROJECT/ietf-mimi-provider-auth/draft-atwood-mimi-provider-auth.md.
acceptance_criteria: -01 text makes the field REQUIRED and covered, independent of its name; mimid enforces it.
